Title: Integrate Office 365 data at scale into Azure by using Data Factory

Body.Content:
As part of the public preview of Microsoft Graph data connect, Azure Data Factory added a new capability. You can get secured, governed, and scalable access of Office 365 data in Azure, and then apply cloud-scale analytics on top of the wealth of organizational data. 

For more information, see the blog post.
